summary: Orion S.A. filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, announcing a routine interim quarterly dividend of $0.0207 per common share, about $1.2 million in aggregate, payable January 19, 2027, to holders of record December 11, 2026. Luxembourg withholding tax of 15% applies, subject to exemptions. No advisor, board recommendation, or structural complexity beyond the standard dividend mechanics was disclosed. This is an ordinary capital-return event rather than a special situation; watch for subsequent quarterly dividend declarations, earnings trends, and any shift in capital allocation policy.
